title: Technology profiles and deterministic agent document navigation
objective: Extend the existing quality authority with broad technology rules and a safe, versioned document routing and handoff contract, preserving prior catalog identity and consumer gates.
approved_sources: Human implementation, checks, independent reviews, PR and Codex review authorization on 2026-10-14
Official source references recorded in the versioned technology extension
Independent Full and repair Delta closure records; functional reviewed head 64133a73668a60cd113e7088925542176d6f6a13. Final evidence-only commit/publication identities are recorded separately.

acceptance.description: Broad technology extension includes PowerShell, Bash and PostgreSQL with primary-source provenance and explicit mandatory/default/free decision levels.
Deterministic navigation resolves role/task/component paths to the complete required context with safe paths and no execution of candidate commands.
Frozen handoff verification rejects stale/tampered/incomplete context, unknown scope, broken references and weakening of active inherited navigation.
Generated consumers, all supported provider combinations and updates preserve existing authority, protected local files, legacy absence and inactive seed behavior.
Current and predecessor validation, compilers, scenario/negative tests, full tests and workflow syntax checks pass.
Independent plan review, two frozen Full reviews, finding triage and any required Delta reviews complete with actual scoped evidence.
PR published at verified identity, required CI status inspected and requested Codex review trigger/result visible on PR; runtime limitations explicitly recorded.

manual_evidence: Actual delegation/read-context smoke where available, separately scoped from native provider discovery
PR identity, CI and visible Codex review; unavailable clients are explicitly unexecuted

stop_conditions: Failed required check without resolved diagnosis
Unexpected overwrite or weakening of local policy
forbidden_actions: Downstream writes or repository setting mutations
